alerts.title: Google Ads connection failing — no data
alerts.detail: Google Ads API returned 403 USER_PERMISSION_DENIED. The account requires the manager's login-customer-id header to authorise access. No spend, conversion or pacing data can be collected until the connection is fixed.
alerts.action: Re-authorise Bloomable Google Ads in Campaign Forge with the correct MCC login-customer-id.

alerts.title: Spend with zero conversions
alerts.detail: Campaign '2022-Heriz Gallery - Search - Competitor - Phrase' spent R2,957.97 over the last 30 days with 0 conversions (1,019 clicks). Competitor-term traffic is not converting.
alerts.action: Review search terms / landing page or pause the competitor campaign.

alerts.title: CPA far above account average
alerts.detail: Campaign 'Furniture-Performance Max | 13-05-2026' is converting at R741 CPA vs the account's best campaign at ~R16 CPA (≈45× higher). R1,824 spent for 2.46 conversions.
alerts.action: Check PMax asset group / audience signals and conversion tracking; consider lowering budget until CPA stabilises.

alerts.title: High CPA on Refurbished Rugs
alerts.detail: Campaign 'Refurbished Rugs | Search | 30-1-26' spent R3,001 for 6.23 conversions (R481 CPA) — well above the R16 CPA on the main generic campaign.
alerts.action: Tighten match types and negatives, or reallocate budget to the BOF generic campaign.

alerts.title: Budget-constrained (scaling opportunity)
alerts.detail: 'Search - Brand (R6000)' is running at ~R247/day against a R250 daily cap (99% utilisation) at a strong R50 CPA with 148 conversions. It is likely leaving converting traffic on the table.
alerts.action: Consider raising the daily budget — strong CPA with capped delivery.

alerts.title: Budget-constrained at higher CPA
alerts.detail: 'Search - New Vehicles (R9000)' is running at ~R235/day against a R236 cap (99%) but at R261 CPA (27 conversions). Capped, but efficiency is weaker than Brand.
alerts.action: Improve efficiency before scaling; review keywords and bids.

alerts.title: Active campaign not delivering
alerts.detail: 'Rola Toyota Bredasdorp Giveaway_Awareness_April_1000' recorded 0 impressions and R0 spend over the last 30 days. The campaign appears live but is not delivering.
alerts.action: Check campaign status, schedule and budget; archive if intentionally off.

alerts.title: Only engagement objective active — no purchases tracked
alerts.detail: The single active Meta campaign spent R4,439 on an engagement/traffic objective with no purchase or lead conversions recorded for a retail/e-commerce brand. Worth confirming the funnel has a conversion campaign and pixel purchases are firing.
alerts.action: Confirm a conversion/sales campaign is live and the purchase pixel is tracking.

alerts.title: Enabled experiment with no impressions
alerts.detail: 'Search - Brand (R7,500) Experiment' is ENABLED but recorded 0 impressions over the period. Either the experiment has not started serving or split is misconfigured.
alerts.action: Verify the experiment schedule and traffic split.

alerts.title: Daily spend spike vs 7-day average
alerts.detail: EXAMPLE of the spend-spike rule: fires when an account's daily spend exceeds its trailing 7-day average by more than the configured threshold (default 40%). Populated automatically once the daily refresh has ≥7 days of history.
alerts.action: Confirm the increase is intentional (new launch / promo) and not a runaway budget.

alerts.title: ROAS / CPA degradation vs baseline
alerts.detail: EXAMPLE of the performance-trend rule: fires when ROAS drops (or CPA rises) more than the configured threshold vs the trailing 30-day baseline. Computer Mania currently records 107 purchases at healthy efficiency; this is a placeholder showing what a real trend breach will look like.
alerts.action: Diagnose creative fatigue, audience saturation or tracking gaps.

alerts.title: No data returned for >48h
alerts.detail: EXAMPLE of the data-freshness rule: fires when an account returns no rows / zero activity for longer than the configured staleness window (default 48h) while campaigns are enabled. Confirms reporting and delivery are alive.
alerts.action: Check API connection and that campaigns are actually serving.
